policy.historical_pilots: Historical development evidence only; no pooling with future experiments and no second active track.

source_policy.adoption: Exact proposed draft3 evaluation byte budgets and controls; does not freeze or modify upstream.

evaluation.content_bound_excludes: Chat-template, BOS and generation-prompt overhead; not a token bound.
evaluation.input_tokens_requirement: I_t = maximum actual rendered input tokens across the independently specified population and all required conditions, including template/special-token/generation-prompt overhead.

training_sequence.capacity_requirement: Support every complete eligible stage example; at least maximum full-example tokenized length across full H1/H2/H3 datasets under pinned training renderer.
training_sequence.common_content_bound: Frozen Workload section 2: inherited historical P/K byte ceilings, complete canonical targets within draft3 source_raw eligibility and exact header/framing bound; actual token lengths remain profile evidence.
training_sequence.overlength_policy: Dataset/envelope blocker or insufficient candidate/runtime; no candidate-specific exclusion, shortening or subsampling.
training_sequence.splitting_chunking_packing: Prohibited by frozen Workload/Recipe v1; any future change requires explicit candidate-independent version review, never a capacity fallback.
training_sequence.prerequisite: Frozen Workload section 2 defines the format/content policy; actual complete-example dataset and authenticated token/mask receipts remain pending before comparison.

history_envelope_H1_H2_H3.invariant: Full eligible authorized accumulated history at each predeclared authenticated cutoff; accumulated stage prefixes with explicit revision/withdrawal lineage.
history_envelope_H1_H2_H3.chronology: Authorized source, construction, certification and availability precede cutoff and current-target release; frozen Workload sections 2-3 define the label and milestone rules.
history_envelope_H1_H2_H3.capacity: Process entire stage datasets over resumable sessions; corpus need not fit a single sequence.

adaptation_comparison_recipe.within_stage_resume: Only authenticated same-stage checkpoint with matching base/config/history and complete optimizer/scheduler/RNG/sampler/step state under compatible frozen runtime; otherwise restart from ORIGINAL.

resource_accounting.comparison: Selection v1 exact priority and dominance rules on matched workloads/bounds; no weighted score.
resource_accounting.rule: Observe hardware, reject insufficient runtime, work locally and verify durable Drive checkpoints; no requirement weakening.

local_deployment.latency_policy: Frozen Workload section 5: reported comparison dimension only; no numerical hard threshold. Operational completion/resource-integrity remains required.
local_deployment.prototype_workload: Provisionally inherit evaluation message/output envelope; added product workload requires prior specification.
local_deployment.required: Document same-original GGUF/llama.cpp architecture/template route and OS/runtime/cache/offload/conversion/storage peaks.

intended_prototype_license_use.required: Source-based checkpoint/stack terms must permit or not prohibit required activities; document and resolve conditions, not legal conclusions.

common_requirements.native_authority: Pinned ORIGINAL base + native PEFT adapter where applicable + frozen native Hugging Face/PEFT runtime/tokenizer/template/controls.
common_requirements.deployment: Separate merge/export -> quantization -> GGUF -> llama.cpp fidelity track; no numerical equivalence assumed and no rewrite of native results.
common_requirements.failure_rule: BLOCKED_NO_ELIGIBLE_SUBJECT / requirements review if no candidate satisfies the frozen envelope on free compute; no silent weakening.

common_requirements.rule: Review and freeze justified requirements independently of candidate preference before landscape comparison. Blocked numbers are not invented; no execution or audit authorized.

comparison_rules.resource_dominance: No worsening in compared dimensions; strict improvement with nonoverlapping bounds or matched evidence for the same frozen workload.
comparison_rules.stack_dominance: Strict subset of required custom patches, kernels, conversions, manual steps and unpinned dependencies, with the same supported lifecycle.

incumbent_advantage.replacement_requires: Strict dominance improvement at priority 1, 2 or 3; equality at all earlier priorities; no demonstrated regression in other burden dimensions or comparable independent coding evidence.

redundancy.representative_rule: Hard gates, exact five priorities, then incumbent advantage; one representative per evidenced equivalent-role group.
redundancy.exact_tie_without_eligible_incumbent: UTF-8 bytewise ascending repository@immutable_revision; administrative resolution after equality through priority 5, never for incomparability.

completion.Drive_publication: Immutable versioned blobs verified first; final completion receipt references sealed manifest; consumers verify the entire referenced bundle.

storage.training_IO: Work locally where possible; package, hash, upload and verify durable checkpoints rather than high-churn writes to many small Drive files.

training.within_stage_resume: Only authenticated same-stage checkpoint with matching base, history, recipe, optimizer, scheduler, RNG, sampler and step state under compatible frozen runtime; otherwise restart stage from original.
